thread:
emma_finance: FYI invoice INV-2026-06-16 for Horizon shows 1,860,000 embedding units for Jun 2 but ledger/db show 930,000. Not a x10 case. Anyone seen duplicate export runs or backfills?

rick_billing: Checking export audit logs now.

billing-bot: export-job #exp-20260616-01 started 2026-06-16T03:05:12Z; export-job #exp-20260616-02 started 2026-06-16T03:05:45Z

nina_ops: Whoa two export jobs started within the same minute for overlapping windows. That smells like a scheduler race.

rick_billing: I pulled the CSVs; both exports contain the same rows for horizon_customer_id=hz-42. Each export sums to 930,000 embedding_units, and invoice concatenated both files -> 1,860,000.

emma_finance: So the invoice system is concatenating outputs rather than deduping by export batch id. Root cause could be scheduler triggered duplicate jobs plus no dedupe check.

tom_sales: Customer reached out: "We're being billed double for Jun 2." They're understandably upset.

nina_ops: Scheduler logs: a transient DB timeout caused the job launcher to think the first job failed, and it retried; both runners picked up the same window because the lock acquisition wasn't atomic.

rick_billing: Repro steps: disable job lock in staging, trigger export -> two files produced and invoice builder concatenates them.

emma_finance: Action plan: 1) void INV-2026-06-16 and issue INV-2026-06-16-R1 with deduped totals 2) credit memo CM-2026-06-16-HORIZON 3) patch job launcher to use DB transactional lock + mark export batch id on files 4) add invoice builder dedupe by batch id and checksum 5) run sweep for other invoices in 03:00-03:10 UTC on 2026-06-16.

rick_billing: I'll implement dedupe in invoice builder first (quick fix) and backfill a corrected export run for affected customers.

nina_ops: I'll add a healthcheck that asserts only one export job per window and alert when >1. Also adding a retry-backoff to job launcher so it doesn't spawn a second job on transient errors.

tom_sales: Draft customer message: "Hi Horizon 	60 we discovered our export pipeline submitted the same billing window twice due to a scheduler race. We've issued a corrected invoice and credit memo; apologies for the inconvenience. Your account rep is available to walk through details"

emma_finance: Approved. Kevin (CFO) verbally okayed credits < $20k for customer experience; finance will escalate if above.

billing-bot: adj-request #adj-2026-06-16-hz42 created by rick_billing

emma_finance: Rick, prioritize creating INV-2026-06-16-R1 and the credit memo. Nina, ping when the scheduler change is deployed to prod.

rick_billing: INV-2026-06-16-R1 and CM-2026-06-16-HORIZON created; corrected embedding_units = 930,000. Sending to customer now.

tom_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick correction and for explaining the fix." :thumbsup:
